author: ETA PRIME
description:
In this video, I’m building a custom Micro PC for under $100 using a used Samsung Galaxy S20 FE with a busted screen. By leveraging Samsung DeX and a few Amazon parts, we’ve created a surprisingly powerful Snapdragon 865 desktop capable of 1440p output, PC game emulation, and high-end Android gaming.
We’ll dive into how to unlock 1440p resolution using Samsung Good Lock, test out PC titles like Silksong via Game Native, and see how this budget beast handles Emulation (PS2/GameCube) and popular titles like Minecraft and Roblox.
